tvShow.name: Beyblade X
tvShow.overview: Beginner blader Robin Kazami joins up with influencer Multi Nana-iro and former champion Jaxon Cross to form this unlikely trio - ready to climb to the top of The X and win the title of champion blader!

episodes.name: New Chapter Celebration! Grand Reopening of Beyblade Sushi - Go Shoot!
X
episodes.overview: After his teammates leave, amateur Blader Robin Kazami has no choice but to join the mysterious Blader X.

episodes.name: Multi-Colored Ambush
episodes.overview: After revealing his true identity and forming Team Persona with Robin, Jaxon signs the new team up for a pro-selection match.

episodes.name: Team Persona
episodes.overview: After their battle with the mega-popular Multi Nana-iro, Jaxon set his sights on a potential third member for Team Persona.

episodes.name: Bey Sponsor
episodes.overview: Now that they're officially pros, the hunt is on for Team Persona's Bey Sponsor, who will help them train and climb The X.

episodes.name: To The X
episodes.overview: Now that Team Persona is officially sponsored by Komaba Sushi, the team is finally ready to battle at The X.

episodes.name: Lion's Jungle
episodes.overview: Instead of training, Robin, Jaxon, and Multi set off to Lion's Jungle to scout out their opponents, Team Zooganic, and see if they could gather any intel.

episodes.name: Team Zooganic
episodes.overview: It's Team Persona's debut match, and they're set to go head-to-head with the inimitable Team Zooganic.

episodes.name: The Mask and the King
episodes.overview: The Persona-Zooganic showdown is locked at one point each. It has all come down to Jaxon's battle with Zooganic's leader, Titus Manju.

episodes.name: Beycrafter
episodes.overview: After their victory against Team Zooganic, Multi uses some Beycrafting skills to help Robin improve his game.

episodes.name: The Pro Realm
episodes.overview: Team Phalanx is hanging on to their sponsorship by a thread. Their upcoming match with Team Persona is their last chance to stay in the limelight.

episodes.name: Warden's Exam
episodes.overview: After failing Warden's Exam, Robin wonders if he can ever get to the same level as his teammates.

episodes.name: The Final Battle
episodes.overview: Team Persona enters the Solo Battle Fest, a series of exhibition matches.

episodes.name: The First Fan
episodes.overview: With all eyes on Blader X and Multi Nana-iro, Robin finds his first fan.

episodes.name: Jax-ercise
episodes.overview: Ms. Myoden informs everyone that a new Blader has broken Jaxon's record.

episodes.name: Riddles and Beys
episodes.overview: At Zonamos House Bladers can not only battle but also solve riddles

episodes.name: Noblesse Oblige
episodes.overview: Team Persona have just one riddle left to solve!

episodes.name: Bey Timeshift
episodes.overview: A mysterious Bey has been distributed all over the city.

episodes.name: Pride
episodes.overview: After switching their Beys, Team Phalanx is on a winning streak.

episodes.name: Zip and Zoom
episodes.overview: Team Persona is a guest at Zip and Zoom.

episodes.name: Memories of Sushi
episodes.overview: Team Persona have to raise Robin's popularity with fans.

episodes.name: Pop Production
episodes.overview: Multi helps Jaxon and Robin up their fashion game.

episodes.name: Black and White
episodes.overview: Team Persona’s match against Yggdrasil is here!

episodes.name: True Heart
episodes.overview: Blaze is nowhere to be seen at the second battle of the Persona-Yggdrasil match.

episodes.name: Arrival of the Fastest
episodes.overview: Blaze Fujiwara finally arrives at the match.

episodes.name: Proof of the Fastest
episodes.overview: The battle to determine the team's results for the Persona-Yggdrasil match has begun.

episodes.name: Invitation
episodes.overview: The Shuffle Battle Fest, an event where B4 breaks existing teams apart and creates a new group of teams, will be held.

episodes.name: The End of Persistence
episodes.overview: Takumi is holding Bey battles against multiple amateurs for some reason.

episodes.name: The King and the Phoenix
episodes.overview: The Shuffle Battle Fest has finally begun! In this event, previously unimagined teams clashed from the very first match.

episodes.name: Mask and Meat Buns
episodes.overview: The Battle between Blader X and Jian begins. Titus tells Mr. Taisho how he met the Zooganic members and what makes them strong.

episodes.name: Riddles and Pop
episodes.overview: The Shuffle Battle Fest continues, and Multi's team, Multi and Me, goes up against Top Boyz.

episodes.name: My Teammates
episodes.overview: The match between Team Multi and Me and Team Top Boyz enters its final battle.

episodes.name: New Partner
episodes.overview: The last day of the Shuffle Battle Fest has arrived, and Robin's team, Found Family, is ready for battle.

episodes.name: Our Promise
episodes.overview: It's the Found Family's final battle and time for Meiko Myoden to take the stage.

episodes.name: A Rainbow Guest
episodes.overview: Jaxon and Robin are helping out at Komaba Sushi when Sigrid Nana-iro comes looking for something to eat.

episodes.name: The Dream Contest
episodes.overview: Now that the Shuffle Battle Fest voting polls have closed, the All-Star Battle is set to begin!

episodes.name: Bladership
episodes.overview: Robin loses in the All-Star to Packu, Multi picks up where he left off.

episodes.name: Unpredictable
episodes.overview: The second Blader for the dreams is the unpredictable Rex Jura.

episodes.name: Return of the Queen
episodes.overview: It's time for the living legend, Quinn Manju, to take the stage.

episodes.name: The Greatest Blader
episodes.overview: The final clash of the All-Star Battle is underway.

episodes.name: The Other Mask
episodes.overview: Someone calling themselves Blader Y appears in Xenon City, battling Pro Bladers.

episodes.name: The Three Masks
episodes.overview: Blader Y’s not the only masked stranger hunting pros.

episodes.name: XYZ
episodes.overview: It’s up to Robin to come up with a plot to lure out these troublesome masked Bladers.

episodes.name: Pendragon, Back Then
episodes.overview: This is a story of how Team Pendragon used to be.

episodes.name: Family, Back Then
episodes.overview: Multi tells Robin about the history of his Bey, Scythe Incendio.

episodes.name: You, Back Then
episodes.overview: A young Blader arrives in Xenon City, full of dreams.

episodes.name: Time Off
episodes.overview: Robin heads back to his hometown with Jaxon before the title match.

episodes.name: Battle at the Top
episodes.overview: At last, it’s Team Persona’s battle against Team Pendragon.

episodes.name: The Nana-iro Showdown
episodes.overview: Multi goes up against Sigrid Nana-iro in the first battle of the title match.

episodes.name: Something Xtraordinary
episodes.overview: Pendragon’s second Blader is Khrome Ryugu; it's Blader X's turn to take the stage.

episodes.name: The Two Xs
episodes.overview: After a head-on collision cracks Buster Dran, Khrome reflects on his time with Jaxon.

episodes.name: The Most Fun Ever
episodes.overview: In the final battle, Blader Z seeks revenge while Robin is cheered on by his teammates.

episodes.name: Restart
episodes.overview: They might have lost, but Team Persona still has their sights set on the top of The X.

episodes.name: Signs of a New Era
episodes.overview: Zooganic and Yggdrasil are likely candidates to be contenders in the next Title Match.

episodes.name: Path of Resolve
episodes.overview: With Khrome missing, Team Pendragon is not allowed to battle in an official match.

episodes.name: Advance Bey Timeshift
episodes.overview: Takumi's visit to Yggdrasil Research is interrupted by Karla Konjiki.

episodes.name: Star Plot
episodes.overview: Tenka Shiroboshi appears at Komaba Sushi, demanding a battle with Blader X.

episodes.name: Tri-Blader Battle
episodes.overview: Finally, Team Persona's next match has been set against not one but two teams!

episodes.name: Triple Battle
episodes.overview: When Zonamos passes on an opportunity to pose a riddle, Multi knows something is up!

episodes.name: Blader S
episodes.overview: With Blader X indisposed, a new Blader helps Team Persona: the mysterious Blader S!

episodes.name: The Multi-Coloured Trial
episodes.overview: Blaze, Zonamos, and Yuni go to a remote Yggdrasil Research lab when a guest arrives!

episodes.name: Invincible
episodes.overview: At last, Blader X takes on Tenka.

episodes.name: The Prestigious Bey Academy
episodes.overview: Multi visits the prestigious Bey academy to ask an old mentor for help.

episodes.name: The Manju Clan
episodes.overview: On the quest to learn more about Beycrafting, Multi visits the home of the Manju Clan.

episodes.name: The Shapeless Shadow
episodes.overview: While chatting with Joka, Multi expresses feelings of anxiety towards this ‘new era’.

episodes.name: First Flight
episodes.overview: When Tenka asks Robin what made him start Blading, he reminisces about his old friend.

episodes.name: Something Captivating
episodes.overview: Robin wants to give Tsubasa advice, but he needs to prove his strength as a Blader.

episodes.name: Silver Wolf
episodes.overview: Packun shares a rumour that could upend the Blading world!

episodes.name: Light and Dark
episodes.overview: Ginro invites Jaxon to join the fight to save the world from the Shadow Pros.

episodes.name: Shadowy Underground
episodes.overview: Ginro and the others try to rescue Packun from the Shadow Pros.

episodes.name: Dread Dragon
episodes.overview: Byte appears and tempts Ciel with the power of the ‘Dread Dragon’.

episodes.name: To That Place
episodes.overview: Khrome has been missing but now he’s come face to face with Omega Shiroboshi.

episodes.name: Labyrinth of Riddles and Terror
episodes.overview: Zonamos House hosts an event where fans get to battle Blader X…if they can solve riddles!

episodes.name: The Star Battle
episodes.overview: The Star Battle begins: Pro and Amateur Bladers launch into battle.

episodes.name: Cursed
episodes.overview: When Persona meets with Gordias, their first battle is between each team's leader.

episodes.name: Return of the Knight
episodes.overview: Multi completes an epic Beycrafting journey and returns to Team Persona with a new Bey!

episodes.name: The Path of the Demon Dragon
The Fox's Seven Forms, The Tanuki's Eight Forms
The X That Devours The Stars
Destruction
episodes.overview: The Persona fan meeting is a huge success. As rumors of a pro blader hunt spread, the identity of the 100th challenger in the challenge battle becomes clear...!?

episodes.name: The Second X
episodes.overview: The Persona group rushes outside after experiencing a violent tremor, only to be shocked by a sight. Furthermore, a giant hologram of Kurosu Zero declares that Beyblade is doomed...

episodes.name: The End of the Demon Dragon

seasons.name: Beyblade X
seasons.overview: Aiming to become a professional Blader, Robin Kazami meets former champion Jaxon Cross, also known as Blader X, and forms a team so that they can aim for the top of The X. But what awaits them is a spectacular battle that no one has ever seen before.
